# TaskPal

> TaskPal is a browser-local task manager for creating, completing, deleting and reading tasks without an account.

## Public information

- [TaskPal](https://task-pal-eight.vercel.app/): The task application.
- [How To Use TaskPal](https://task-pal-eight.vercel.app/help.html): Task controls, long text, saving and backups.
- [Data & Privacy](https://task-pal-eight.vercel.app/privacy.html): Browser-local data, downloaded backups, fonts and analytics.

## Product limits

Tasks belong to a browser profile on this site. There is no account-based cloud backup or automatic cross-device sync. Browser storage is not an encrypted vault. Personal task content is not public site content and must not be requested for discovery or indexing.
